push.title: L 3-6 vs CALMA UNITED | You: 9.4
push.body:
A 9.4 against CALMA UNITED, BellyTb1. You made the hard things look ordinary, and that's a compliment.

THE GOOD
+ 7 shots at CALMA UNITED's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ 1 key pass. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ 1.6 over your norm. Keep stacking days like this.
+ Passes attempted 36, up from your usual 25. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 6 goals conceded nudged you up +0.3. Every bit counts.

THE BAD
- 2 of 7 shots on target. Old coach's advice: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. One rep at a time.
- 64% passing (23 of 36, down from your usual 76%). Tiny tweak: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder. Feet first, then flair.
- Partners in crime on shot selection, you and PhogsToffees. Partners in the fix too: cut it back to each other.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 2. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Lost 3-6. It stings, and stings fade.

Drill: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Keep that fire burning. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-6 vs CALMA UNITED | You: 8.5
push.body:
An 8.5, PhogsToffees. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at CALMA UNITED's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ Tackles attempted 7, up from your usual 4. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ Completed passes 36, up from your usual 25. You earned that one the honest way.
+ Your vision plus BellyTb1's finishing equals a very happy coach.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Next rep: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. Steady does it.
- Won 0 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 22%). Here's the play: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away. Trust me on that one.
- You and BellyTb1, same lesson: shot selection. Same answer: cut it back to each other.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 2. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- In our wins you average 8 giveaways; here it was 13. That has to tighten up.

Rondo time: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

Progress over perfection. - Coach Lasso
